evaluation_contract.bootstrap: 5000 paired episode-cluster resamples, seed77077; five-seed model average per genuine query; uncertainty conditional on fitted models
evaluation_contract.point_prediction: coordinate-wise median of the fitted two-Laplace mixture, fixed 26-step bisection

guard: Whole model pre/post update live check via budgeted_optimizer, guarded optimizer.step, save_training_checkpoint. Entire original fit/checkpoint/per-case outputs in Git; never alter existing ME054-075 results.
loss: proper two-component Laplace NLL + 0.2*BCE(global genuine motion >=0.025 physical mean14D change). Global motion probability is an auxiliary forecast, NOT identical to mixture-component assignment.
measurable_promotion_rule: Provisional DEV_GAIN only if all five seeds reduce MAE >=5% against ME076 and persistence, five-seed-average movement-rich MAE <=0.95*persistence; no task >10% regression relative to persistence; episode-cluster 95% CI upper(model-persistence)<0. Otherwise report REGRESSION, MIXED_TRADEOFF or INCONCLUSIVE. No untouched TEST.
primary_development_measure: Same exact 960 ME076 observed query origins per seed, physical joint MAE; movement-rich >=0.025 physical units, near-stationary, tasks, motion Brier and coherent marginal 90% interval score.

real_world_source.name: BodenAI/RW-RL-HIL-Dataset, frozen revision 9290f5a96dc91ea58256e81d9ce2dd9621890b51, original ME064 registered five authentic tasks previously exposed FIT 160 episodes; CC-BY-4.0 with publisher attribution

scientific_purpose: Train an integrated native motion-selective distribution and proper conditional median on authentic physical transitions, suppressing false change predictions while preserving changing-state skill. Exposed DEV only; no architectural attribution or superiority.
source_train_fit_qualification: metadata and normalized state/action computed only from designated FIT episode members; source fingerprint includes entire original five-task FIT 160 archive but eval rows never used for normalization
strict_no_claims: no original model trained before this registration

training_budget.selection: final update only, no DEV tuning
training_budget.train_window_sampling: equal task round-robin, uniform eligible actual transitions; no outcome oversampling
